_comment: Grow's worlds, in home order. `live` false = shown as coming. `kind` picks the screen (GrowPanel.jsx SCREENS): `lessons` = LessonWorld fed by its hook (lib/useWordsWorld.js, lib/useHadithWorld.js), `prayer` = the step map. Colour: theme.json `world` by id.
_lesson: A lessons world's numbers: `new` new items, up to `most-new` when little is due, `size` items in all (the rest due reviews). `stages`: items learnt (server 'known') to finish each stage. `unit`: what the items are called.
